## ===================================================================================================================
## Double Aperture-matched PSF-corrected Multi-band Photometry +
## enhanced Bayesian Photometric Redshifts (BPZ2.0),
## Stellar-Mass & B-band Absolute Magnitude estimates +
## for sources detected on a weighted sum of WFC3/IR images
## in each of the 25 CLASH Clusters,
## based on drizzled (65mas) science images produced by the CLASH:
##  - Koekemoer A. M., et al., 2003, hstc.conf, 337
##  - Koekemoer A. M., et al., 2011, ApJS, 197, 36
## Only detections within the area covered by the 16-bands were kept,
## to guarantee a homogeneous on-target exposure time.
## ===================================================================================================================
## Filter System (16):
##   - UV [WFC3] (4): F225W, F275W, F336W, F390W
##   - OPTICAL [ACS] (7): F435W, F475W, F606W, F625W, F775W, F814W, F850LP
##   - NIR [WFC3] (5): F105W, F110W, F125W, F140W, F160W
## ===================================================================================================================
## Release Date (v1.0): May, 2017
## Any further information, please contact with:
##     * Alberto Molino: albertomolino.work@gmail.com
##     * Txitxo Benitez: benitez@iaa.es
